title: Organ Giants | J.S. Bach Complete Organ Works Recital 3 | William Fox
description:
This recital is part of a two year long series to celebrate 150 years of the Willis heart of the Grand Organ of St Paul's. Join William Fox as he continues his 30 recitals of the complete organ works of J.S. Bach.

This recital is being streamed from an empty building and behind closed doors, and is compliant with current COVID-19 guidance.

Recitals form an integral part of the weekly liturgical and musical offering at St Paul’s, and we are pleased to be able to share this offering with you.

For details of what is being played today, with notes about each piece, please click here: https://www.stpauls.co.uk/worship-music/music/concerts-and-events/sunday-organ-recitals
